component.name: FujiNet Go PMD 85
component.summary: Self-contained Tesla PMD 85 with built-in FujiNet

description.p: A Tesla PMD 85 emulator with a FujiNet built in. The machine boots into FujiNet CONFIG, from where ROM modules and other software are mounted from the network or a local SD folder and loaded straight into the MegaModule.
The emulation is GPMD85Emulator's: the PMD 85-1, 85-2, 85-2A and 85-3, Mato, Didaktik Alfa and Alfa 2 and Consul 2717, with the MIF 85 music interface and the PMD 32 disk drive.
